text:
Alice M: Heads-up: vendor courier updated ETA for the on-prem rack — customs clearance expected Tue 15:00 PST. Need cross-cloud quota alignment and Dedicated pool slot mapping before we racked. Can infra ops confirm quotas on GCP (europe-west1) and AWS (eu-west-2)?

Raj P: Checking. AWS side we have requested increase for A100 count; pending approval. Current soft limit: 64, requested 96. GCP quota for GPUs in europe-west1 is weird — request submitted last week, no reply. I'll ping vendor + AM.

Sophie L: If customs slips we should have a fallback: can we temporarily shift some load to Dedicated burst in us-west? What are network implications for latency-sensitive canaries?

Linus K: From network POV: cross-region will add ~30-50ms tail on KV cache misses. For canaries we can route only async/batch jobs. For latency-critical, prefer local eu nodes. Also we need to add rack's BGP ASN to our firewall whitelist; vendor provided ASN 64512.

Alice M: Thanks. Raj — can you paste the quota commands you ran? Also need a list of instance profiles the new racks will use (h100 vs a100). Vendor said mixed: 8x H100 + 16x A100 per rack.

Raj P: Commands: ```gcloud compute regions describe europe-west1 --project=redwood-infra | jq '.quotas[] | select(.metric=="GPUS")'``` and ```aws service-quotas get-service-quota --service-code ec2 --quota-code L-024F3A9A``` Will also open ticket with vendor AM. Rack mix confirmed by vendor: H100 on the first two pods, rest A100.

deploy-bot: Deploy-bot: New quota request created (REQ-3892). Status: pending. Notifying support@vendor.com

Sophie L: Can we get a quick mapping table of which RL agents / dedicated pools will be assigned to this rack? If not, propose provisional mapping: prod-rl-high -> rack-1(H100), batch-training -> rack-2(A100).

Alice M: Provisional mapping accepted. Raj, once AWS limit approved, please update the reserved pool allocations. Also set canary route to eu-west1-d first.

Raj P: Will do. FYI vendor mentioned customs docs missing one signature; pushing courier to expedite. ETA could move to Wed morning if not fixed.

Linus K: For firewall: adding ASN + IP ranges when vendor shares manifest. Also need to coordinate certs — customer-managed KMS? Vendor supports external HSM but needs cert signing request. Sophie, any objections to using customer KMS for Private deployments?

Sophie L: No objection. Prefer HSM for keys at rest. Let's create an action item card in infra-ops board.

Alice M: Action items: Raj open quota follow-ups (AWS/GCP) + update REQ-3892; Linus prep firewall + cert checklist; Sophie create infra-ops card. I'll monitor vendor ETA. :eyes:

Raj P: :thumbsup: I'll update thread when quotas change.

deploy-bot: Deploy-bot: REQ-3892 -> updated: vendor replied, awaiting customs docs. Assigned to Raj P.
